answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 145305 Country: India Title: I want to ask that sprit which is used to clean a wound is paak or naapaak. Question: I am a doctor. I want to ask that sprit which is used to clean a wound is paak or naapaak. Answer ID: 145305 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 14/194/H=3/1438) Spirit is in actual a kind of alcohol but it has been regarded pure since it is made of other ingredients and its use is common. (Hashia Imdad al-Fatwa 1/131, and Hashia Mahmoodia 18/183). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
